title: A globally defined compressible polyconvex isotropic energy satisfying the true-stress-true-strain monotonicity condition (TSTS-M++)
summary: We construct a compressible isotropic energy on $\mathrm{GL}^+(3)$ combining polyconvexity and global true-stress-true-strain monotonicity (TSTS-M++), answering a question of Wollner, Holzapfel and Neff. For every $μ>0$ and $k>0$, the energy $W_k(F)=\fracμ{2k}[\exp(k(\lVert F\rVert^2+3J^{-1}+J-7))-1]$, $J=\det F$, is polyconvex and strictly rank-one convex. Its Cauchy-stress response satisfies TSTS-M++ globally if and only if $k\ge1/(8\sqrt3)$. The reference state is stress free with positive infinitesimal shear and bulk moduli.
